latHint: Think an angry frown - not bright sunlight.
pivHint: The GLARE of the sun hurts your eyes - but to GLARE at someone means giving them an angry what?
winText: Dirty look. GLARE was the pivot - sunlight to a SCOWL.
lossText: SCOWL - an angry frown. GLARE was the pivot: sun GLARE to a GLARE at someone.
